lines.zh: 我这副 2016 年的身子，走路带响。
lines.en: This 2016 body of mine lands loudly.
I walk stooped, shoulders above my head.
My claws leave pale scratches on the stone.
Every three steps, I hop.

lines.zh: 下界的地面很烫，正合我。
lines.en: The Nether floor is hot. Suits me.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆边走过，皮肤发亮。
lines.en: I pass the lava and my skin glistens.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边甩手上的火。
lines.en: I walk, shaking fire off my hand.
Short legs, quick steps.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁走，避开热气。
lines.en: I hug the rock wall, away from the heat.
I shift along while staring at you.

lines.zh: 我踩过的碎石还在冒烟。
lines.en: The rubble I step on still smokes.

lines.zh: 我蹲着，两只手撑在膝上。
lines.en: I crouch with both hands on my knees.
This body is thicker than the old one.
I wait for the fireball to build.
I tilt my head and listen.

lines.zh: 下界的风把我的皮吹干。
lines.en: Nether wind dries my hide.
My spine keeps rising and falling.
I am in no hurry; you move first.
I sink my claws into a crack.
Do you know a face like mine?
I am broader than I look.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，正好在射程里。
lines.en: You stand right inside my range.
I look up, fire in my eyes.

lines.zh: 我这副身子，比前一代凶。
lines.en: This body is meaner than the last one.
I grin, all my teeth showing.
I smell iron on you.

lines.zh: 你手放在哪儿，我都看见。
lines.en: I see where your hands are.

lines.zh: 我退了两步，爪子刮着地。
lines.en: I back two steps, claws scraping.
My blood drips and smokes on stone.
I did not expect you to land it.
The fireball slipped from my hand.
My shoulder has dropped a little.
Again, and I stop playing.
My fireball was knocked wide.
Don't think throwing fire is all I do.
That is not enough for one burn.
What I want is for it to burn.
Holding it up is foolish.
I am not hungry; I want a fight.
Throw it and I will play with it.
The smell is too faint.
Do not pull your hand back; I am lighting it.
Food is useless to an imp.
I prefer it roasted.

lines.zh: 你一撞，我就地滚了半圈。
lines.en: One bump and I roll half a turn.
I dig in, steady, and spring back.
Let me by; I go underneath.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的爪子刮到你了。
lines.en: That bump dragged my claws across you.
The ash rises and covers you briefly.
I do not retreat; I circle.
You stomp, and I am already clear.
Again, and I leap on you.
Demons have no such custom.
I have only fire in my hands.
Plenty of my kind; no need to look.
I would rather burn a forest.
That is a strange question.
When I laugh, sparks fly.
This is no place for such talk.
I am thinking about my next fireball.
Get lost.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块烫手的碎石。
lines.en: I pick up a hot piece of rubble.
I turn it over in my hand.
It cracks; the inside is red.
This bone will be useful.
I carry it; it still sparks.
Too heavy; I kick it along.
Argent slag. I keep it.
No one will come asking.
I pinch it between two claws.
I see your hands.
I can throw this far.
The fireball grows in my hand.
First, a cry.
Behind you is a lava channel.
My legs are already bent.
I do not need to close in.
Do not run; you will fall in the fire.
This one is for you.
I have my aim.
Do you hear the furnace sound?
Here I go.
I follow, hop by hop.
You go left; I throw left.
I keep moving, and so does the fire.
I crouch on a rock and wait.
I go around, a little slower.
I am shaping a second fireball.
All stone here. No water.
You have looked back twice.
I move along the wall's shadow.
You stepped on rubble. I heard.

lines.zh: 我把火藏在背后，慢慢来。
lines.en: I hide the fire behind me and close in.

lines.zh: 你手抬起来，是想扔东西。
lines.en: Your hand rises. You mean to throw.
One more retreat and you are at the edge.
I laugh and sparks scatter.
One swipe and the skin splits.
I leap for your face.
You strike back; I tumble away.
I press fire to your chest.
My claws are quicker than your hands.
I rake the back of your knee.

lines.zh: 这一下，火星溅到你脸上。
lines.en: Sparks splash your face.
I miss and slam the wall.
I come up on your flank.
Your back is burning.
I pull back two steps, laughing.
One more rake.
Your shield will not stop fire.
I tumble out of the fire.
Fire from 2016 tastes the same.

lines.zh: 这具身体比记忆里更重。
lines.en: This body is heavier than I remember.
The first thing I see is a red sky.
Claws touch stone first.
I shape my first fireball.
It burns well.
I laugh. The sound is harsh.
I choose this rock to stand on.
I want to set something alight first.
Fire is only warmth to me.

lines.zh: 我摔在石头上，半天爬不起来。
lines.en: I hit stone and cannot rise for a while.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，你在骗自己。
lines.en: There is no water here. You deceive yourself.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推得翻了两圈。
lines.en: The blast rolls me twice.
An arrow sticks under my ribs.

lines.zh: 有咒力在我皮里游，很凉。
lines.en: A curse swims under my hide, cold.

lines.zh: 雷落在我背上，我抽了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and I jerk.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有，我一直掉。
lines.en: Nothing beneath me; I keep falling.
